title: Impact of Red and Red/NIR OLEDs photobiomodulation effects towards promoting ADMSCs chondrogenic differentiation.
abstract: Photobiomodulation (PBM) uses light to stimulate cellular responses and has the potential to enhance cartilage regeneration through mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) differentiation.
